title: Embraer E-Jets Family (MSFS)
summary: Comprehensive systems, FMS navigation, autopilot flight director laws, and cockpit display engineering for the E170, E175, E190, E195, and E-Freighter.
highlights: Flight Management System (FMS): Waypoint sequencing, lateral/vertical navigation, NavData ARINC-424 cycle parsing, and takeoff/climb performance calculation (V1, VR, V2, thrust limits).
Autopilot & Autoflight Management: Pitch/Roll guidance (LNAV, VNAV PTH/FLCH), ILS/Autoland CAT II/III approach tracking, and autothrottle system.
Cockpit Display Vector Rendering: Primary Flight Display (PFD) speed/altitude tapes, Multi-Function Display (MFD) moving map, and EICAS engine and alert messaging.
Deep Systems Simulation: Multi-bus AC/DC electrical distribution with bus tie logic, 3-circuit hydraulic system with engine/electric pumps and PTU, and pneumatic/pressurization loops.

title: Custom Guitar Electronics & Craft

Custom wiring schematics with high-tolerance CTS potentiometers and orange drop capacitors.

highlights: Engineered real-time lateral navigation (LNAV) trajectory generation and ARINC-424 leg resolution (IF, TF, CF, DF, RF).
Developed Airbus MCDU (Multifunction Control and Display Unit) flight planning pages (F-PLN, INIT, PERF, DIR TO).
Vertical navigation (VNAV) profile solver: top-of-descent (TOD) calculation, step climbs, fuel burn estimation, and speed/altitude constraint adherence.

Modeled engine start/stop interlocks, propeller positioning brake, and aerodynamic drag penalty during mast extension.
Integrated soaring instruments, electrical bus switching, and engine telemetry gauges for official MSFS default aircraft.

highlights: Integrated MSFS built-in avionics suite with custom Garmin G3X glass cockpit layout and engine instrumentation.
Engineered electrical system logic, amphibious landing gear / bilge pump controls, and instrument bus switching.
Configured custom flight deck interaction models and calibrated real-time telemetry.

title: chiagen - Standalone Chia Plotter & Event-Driven Plot Manager
summary: High-performance native C++ standalone Chia generator and event-driven plot manager integrating madMAx43v3r and reference chiapos plotters in-process with real-time hardware telemetry and custom job scheduling.
highlights: Direct in-process multithreaded compilation of madMAx43v3r and chiapos plotters, eliminating external process wrappers and enabling granular phase interception and pause/resume control.
Event-driven plot orchestration engine enabling reactive multi-stage pipelines that trigger staggered jobs upon specific phase completions or disk transfers.
Dual-mode interface providing an immediate-mode GUI (Dear ImGui) with real-time CPU/RAM/Disk I/O telemetry graphs alongside a full CLI mode for headless automated farming servers.

Integrated SoftAP captive portal and SPIFFS flash filesystem for seamless over-the-air Wi-Fi and custom API endpoint setup.
Hardware user interface featuring tactile push-buttons, low-latency JSON REST parsing, and NTP time synchronization.

highlights: Custom reliability layer over UDP with sliding-window ACK/NACK, packet sequencing, and congestion control.
Zero-garbage fixed memory buffer allocation preventing garbage collection hiccups during intense multiplayer matches.
Built-in NAT punchthrough and connection migration handling.

Engineered custom nutrient chiller combining Peltier thermoelectric plates with PC CPU liquid cooling waterblocks.
Automated photoperiod and closed-loop environmental controls (temperature, pH, humidity) with Arduino and SBC relays.

Color-coded ANSI terminal matrix displaying real-time power limits, fan speeds, core/memory clocks, and thermal warnings across 12+ GPU multi-card rigs.
